description: Gets the spectral envelope of file 2 and applies it to file 1 - 'equivalent to formant extraction + formant impose/replace but allows for larger spectral windows' (banner). Content-verified: flat noise shaped by a 4-formant vowel took on the vowel's exact peak/trough structure (+35 dB band contrast at the formant centres). windowsize is in analysis-channel-widths (1-513 enforced) or octave steps with -p; -i IMPOSES the envelope on file 1's own (default REPLACES it); -k keeps the imposed file's loudness contour; bal mixes the originals back in. File 2 must be at least as long as file 1 ('ERROR: First file is longer than 2nd: cannot proceed.' verbatim). EXIT-CONTRACT BUG (stability: unstable): when file 2 is STRICTLY longer the process writes a complete, resynthesisable output and then SIGABRTs at teardown ('free(): invalid size', exit 134) - equal-length pairs exit 0 cleanly. Duration = file 1's (1.5209 / 2.0230 verified). Deterministic.
musical_use: Broad-brush spectral vocoding: file 1 provides the excitation/motion, file 2 the evolving spectral colour. Against formants get/put this trades precision for reach - windowsize is free (huge windows smear the donor's envelope into slow washes of colour; small ones track it tightly), and the -p octave-wise option follows pitch structure rather than linear frequency. Classic moves: noise or dense texture as file 1 + speech as file 2 (talking texture); bright pad as file 1 + percussive loop as file 2 with -k (the loop's loudness AND colour pump the pad). bal pulls the originals back in for parallel-blend subtlety. IMPORTANT: give the engine equal-length inputs (trim first) - a longer file 2 currently reports failure despite writing good output (see known_issues).

windowsize.description: Envelope extraction window, counted in analysis-channel-widths (srate/anal-chans; ~43 Hz each at 1024/44.1k), or in OCTAVE STEPS with -p. CDP-enforced 1 to the channel count ('0'/'600' refused verbatim quoting '(1.000000 to 513.000000)'). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Larger = smoother, broader colour transfer.

bal.description: Proportion of the original files mixed into the output (default 0.0 = none). BANNER DIVERGENCE: the banner describes 'bal > 1' and 'bal < 1' behaviors, but CDP enforces -1 to 1 ('-b3' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[2] Value (3.000000) out of range (-1.000000 to 1.000000)'). Positive leans toward file 1, negative toward file 2 (banner sense). Verified live at 0.5.

pitchwise.description: Count windowsize in octave steps instead of channel-widths. Verified live (render differs).

impose.description: IMPOSE the spectral envelope on top of file 1's own (default: REPLACE file 1's envelope). Verified live.

keep_loudness.description: Keep the loudness contour of the IMPOSED file (file 2); default keeps file 1's. Verified live.

examples.description: Talking texture: vowel colour stamped on noise.
examples.expected_use: Input 1 = the texture, input 2 = the speech/vowel donor (equal lengths). Verified +35 dB formant-band contrast on the probe.

examples.description: Slow colour wash with the donor's dynamics.
examples.expected_use: Huge extraction window smears the donor's envelope; -k lets its loudness pump the result; 30% of the originals blended back.

known_issues: EXIT-CONTRACT BUG (first-class): with file 2 strictly longer than file 1 the binary writes a COMPLETE resynthesisable output, then aborts at teardown ('free(): invalid size', exit 134/SIGABRT) - the engine treats nonzero exit as failure, so USE EQUAL-LENGTH INPUTS (equal pairs exit 0 cleanly). Same broken-teardown class as specfnu modes 19/21.
File 2 shorter than file 1 is a clean refusal: 'ERROR: CANNOT ACHIEVE TASK: / ERROR: First file is longer than 2nd: cannot proceed.' (verbatim).
bal's banner prose ('bal > 1' / 'bal < 1') contradicts the enforced -1..1 range (refusal verbatim) - manual/banner documentation error.
Prints the family 'WARNING: failed to write PEAK data' on some refusal paths - not a failure indicator by itself.
wav input refused; engine auto-PVOCs both inputs. Deterministic (byte-identical reruns).
